import json,os,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/opt/validation/mypy-source')
# Use the owning suite's existing refcount test collection and pytest settings.
result=subprocess.run(['/opt/compiler-build/bin/python','-m','pytest','mypyc/test/test_refcount.py'],cwd=base,env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k!='PYTEST_PLUGINS'})
Path('/reports/compiler-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':result.returncode,'suite':'mypyc/test/test_refcount.py'})+'\n')
raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
